checks.name: Migration approves no existing account; unapproved users cannot found, self-admit, self-promote or mutate
Approval does not verify email; confirmed approved founder must explicitly consent and can bootstrap only once
Explicit independent reviewer appointment grants no person ownership
Even a valid independently reviewed invitation cannot admit an unapproved account; approved acceptance is single-use
Authorized history works; outsider RPC and raw database retrieval fail
Realtime positive control delivers authorized notifications
Block denies both sides direct/group history, pagination, chat list/counts, sends and database RLS; unrelated group member retains history
Existing Realtime subscription denies blocked conversations while unaffected control still delivers
Unblock restores accepted access; removed conversation member loses old history and live notifications
Family membership removal denies old-token RPC, RLS notifications and Realtime without reconnecting
Admission revocation denies existing sessions and rejoining without deleting accounts or family data

scope: Guarded local stack only; no hosted users or data
